username.title: Username
username.description: Username if authenticated via user account.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the queue is accepting tasks.

default_priority.title: Default Priority
default_priority.description: Default priority for tasks in this queue.

max_concurrency.title: Max Concurrency
max_concurrency.description: Max concurrent tasks executed from this queue.

rate_limit_rps.title: Rate Limit Rps
rate_limit_rps.description: Optional token bucket rate limit in requests per second.

oldest_task_age_seconds.title: Oldest Task Age Seconds
oldest_task_age_seconds.description: Oldest pending task age in seconds.

broker_backend.title: Broker Backend
broker_backend.description: Broker backend ('native', 'redis', etc.). Omit or leave empty to keep unchanged.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: Input payload provided to each generated task instance.

misfire_policy.description: Policy when scheduler misses execution window: skip, catch_up, or coalescing.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the schedule is actively generating tasks.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: Target tenant ID (restricted to principal's tenant for non-admins).

status.title: Status
status.description: Task status (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, RETRY_WAIT, DEAD, etc.).

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: Current or last run start time.

worker_id.title: Worker Id
worker_id.description: Worker currently executing or last owner.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: Current or last run start time.

delay_seconds.title: Delay Seconds
delay_seconds.description: Delay before task becomes eligible for execution.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: JSON serializable input parameters for task execution.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Task priority where 10 is highest and 1 is lowest.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Execution retry limit. If omitted, uses queue/engine default.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Execution timeout in seconds. If omitted, uses default.

idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key
idempotency_key.description: Unique caller-provided key to guarantee exactly-once submission semantics.

delay_seconds.title: Delay Seconds
delay_seconds.description: Defer execution by N seconds from submission.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier for multi-tenant fairness and quota isolation.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional caller metadata (e.g. trace context, tags).

username.title: Username
username.description: Unique alphanumeric username (3-50 characters, letters, digits, '-', '_').

password.title: Password
password.description: Plaintext password (min 8 chars, at least one letter and one number).

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: Assigned tenant or project identifier. If omitted, a unique tenant is auto-created from your username. Pass 'default' to join the shared system tenant.
